claims.quote: The term "ugg boots" originated in Australia, initially for utilitarian footwear worn for warmth, and which were often worn by surfers during the 1960s.
claims.note: term and boots began in Australia

claims.quote: Surfer Shane Stedman of Australia has stated in interviews that he invented the ugg boot.
The boots were reportedly being manufactured in 1933 by Blue Mountains Ugg Boots of New South Wales.
